notes.title: Introducing Characters | Lexus Apollo
notes.content:
Hello my fellow gamers, I am Troy and today I will introduce to you Lexus Apollo. Lexus is the leader of the Nation of Craftia.

Backstory/Lore
Lexus of Craftia is a man of honor, wisdom and nobility, and holds dark secrets. Lexus Apollo was born under John Apollo and Alyssa Apollo and brothers with Sigurd Apollo. The last name came from the Gods of Creation and one of the Gods being named Apollo. Lexus would found Craftia after freeing it from chaos and barbarians. Lexus then would be elected their leader. Lexus would establish a military then go on to conquer all the regions of Craftia. Lexus would after maintain Craftia and do some research on something big, finding it but telling no one. A bridge, gate-way to... That something for another day. Soon after this The Galactic Federation would invade.

notes.title: Craftia's Defender - Soundtrack & Music - Release Date and Info
notes.content:
Hello again, it is I, Troy. Today we are announcing the release date for the soundtrack pack for Craftia's Defender.

Release Date
I will just get to the point and release we are releasing on January 13th at 12 AM ET is the release time. So if you live in the CT time zone it would release January 12th, 11 PM. You get it.

Info & Future Plans
At release the sound track will contain 8 epic soundtracks! And a total final file size of 12MBs. In the future we will add more soundtracks as Craftia's Defender continues to develop. We plan to add 4-7 more soundtracks.

notes.title: Introducing Characters | Magnus The Defender
notes.content:
Hello, my name is Troy. Today you will see our main character, Magnus The Defender.

Magnus' Abilities

The Final Cut
Magnus holds a sword of power. This sword by default is weak but will gain power over time. The sword is called "The Final Cut" and steals the soul of its victim to gain more power.

Blast Of Rage
If The Final Cut steals 5 souls in a minute it can release a massive beam to kill a horde of enemies.

Sword Upgrades

Hollow Sword
Brings increased speed and a major damaged upgrade. This is a gift from a character if you prove you are worthy.

Electric Sword
Does extra damage to robotic enemies.

Looooooong Sword
Brings a extended reach for damage and a high damage per hit.

Separated Cut
A dual sword that can be split into two.

The Cut of The Flame
The sword of Apollo and blessed with a fire that will spread to all you is attacked by it.

Chainsaw Sword
Super fast damage and high damaged on heavily armored enemies.

Backstory/Lore
Magnus is from a village far away from the main area of Craftia. But when trouble struck he went straight to the leader of Craftia to be recruited. Magnus is a single child with no brother or sisters.
